text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed for /v1/generate across runtime cluster 'eu-prod-r1'. Alerts: error-rate > 5% for last 5m, 50% increase in gateway timeouts. Paging @oncall-eng :rotating_light:

oncall-eng: acked. pulling runbook now (link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/runbook). who's on SRE?

sara: I'm online, looking at grafana. Error spike started ~1768999800 (~7m ago). Backend 5xxs are concentrated on runtime nodes r-11..r-18. Gateway timeouts +502s in front of runtime.

lucas: I'm runtime lead, saw a small eviction-tuning deploy ~3h ago to prefix cache. Could be related. No infra deployments in last 30m.

sara: quick metric dump: cache_prefix_hit_rate: 86% -> 32% in last 10m; prefix_cache_evictions/sec: 12 -> 450 (spike). origin_kv_error_rate: 0.4% -> 6.2%.

ryan: I can see repeated KV errors in logs: "kv-prefix: checksum mismatch while loading prefix" and then retries hitting origin causing timeouts. sample log:

```
2026-04-02T18:20:09Z r-13 runtime ERROR kv-prefix: failed validate checksum prefix=usr-123 err=corrupt-prefix-data
2026-04-02T18:20:09Z r-13 runtime WARN kv-prefix: fallback to origin fetch, origin_latency=820ms
2026-04-02T18:20:11Z r-13 runtime ERROR api.gateway: downstream_timeout status=504 route=/v1/generate request_id=abcd-1234
```

maria: support here — we've seen multiple incoming tickets referencing timeouts. customers affected: several high-traffic orgs (cust-47, cust-92). ETA-sensitive jobs failing. Need status page update.

kevin: tagging customer-ops to prepare targeted comms for cust-47 and cust-92. Also opening support bundle.

oncall-eng: executing mitigation plan from runbook: 1) reduce pressure on origin by disabling prefix cache on runtime (toggle to bypass); 2) stop eviction storm cause; 3) restart nodes with repeated checksum failures; 4) status update. Rolling steps now.

lucas: I can flip the feature-flag. Commands: 

Disable prefix cache (feature flag):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://admin-api.redwood.internal/v1/feature-flags/prefix_cache -d '{"enabled": false, "reason": "emergency-bypass-1769000123"}'
```

Flush local prefix caches on affected nodes (targeted):
```bash
ssh r-13 sudo systemctl stop redwood-runtime && sudo -u runtime /usr/local/bin/prefix-cache-tool --flush-prefixes --match "usr-*" && sudo systemctl start redwood-runtime
```

oncall-eng: I pushed the feature-flag off at 1769000208. Confirming propagation.

sara: after toggle: cache_prefix_hit_rate -> builtin 0% (bypass), origin_qps down 72%, origin_5xx down to 1.8% within 90s. gateway timeouts dropping. Good initial signal.

lucas: I'm rolling targeted restarts of r-13..r-16 where checksum errors were frequent. Doing 2 at a time. logs show older prefix cache files on disk with mismatched checksums — likely a corruption from earlier eviction compaction job.

ryan: added a temporary routing policy to force direct reads for heavy orgs to avoid cache path:
```bash
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://admin-api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/policies/urgent-bypass -d '{"match_orgs": ["cust-47","cust-92"], "force_direct": true}'
```

maria: posting brief status page: "We are investigating elevated errors impacting generation endpoints; mitigation in progress; some customers may see timeouts. Engineers are rolling mitigations now." Posting at 1769000295.

kevin: customers cust-47/cust-92 notified via DM with instructions to retry and expect short delays.

sara: metrics at 1769000360: total 5xx across cluster dropped from 5.8% -> 1.1%. origin latency normalizing. eviction/sec back to baseline ~8/sec.

oncall-eng: continuing observation. next steps: 1) run fsck on prefix cache store on nodes with checksum errors; 2) identify root cause for corruption (eviction compaction bug?) 3) long-term fix/rollback of eviction tuning deploy if confirmed. Scheduling post-incident task.

lucas: I inspected compaction logs. Compaction run #2026-04-02-17:50 showed interrupted writes on r-14 during a kernel OOM event (noisy neighbor VM). That likely produced partial/corrupt prefix blobs. We'll add sanity-checks and guarded writes.

maria: support update posted with incident id INC-1769000123 and customers aware. No SLA breaches yet flagged, monitoring for retries.

oncall-eng: preparing handoff to second on-call in 1h. Summary for next-shift: eviction compaction likely corrupted on-disk prefix blobs on subset of nodes -> checksum failures -> fallback floods origin -> elevated 5xx/timeouts. Immediate mitigations: feature-flag off, targeted restarts, routing bypass for heavy orgs, support comms.

ryan: creating quick checklist for postmortem and next actions:
- collect corrupted prefix blob list from nodes r-13..r-16 (sha1 list)
- run fsck and repro steps in staging
- revert eviction tuning or harden compaction write paths
- add alert for prefix_checksum_failure rate
- test feature-flag rollback path regularly

sara: agreed. assigning follow-ups: lucas -> runtime fix & compaction hardening (P0); ryan -> postmortem & repro; maria/kevin -> customer comms and impact report.

oncall-eng: handing off to next shift @sara in 1h. Keep alerts unmuted for 2h post-mitigation.

sara: ack. will take it from here. will update when we close incident. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 5xx rate reduced to baseline, mitigation successful. Incident marked as active -> mitigated. Incident ID: INC-1769000123.

maria: preparing first-draft incident notification for customers with timeline and mitigation steps.

oncall-eng: closing pager, leaving incident open for postmortem. last checked 1769000789: metrics stable.

kevin: collecting list of affected customer request IDs to bundle for postmortem (support refs SR-3345, SR-3371).

sara: leaving handoff notes in runbook and creating the postmortem skeleton. Thanks team.
